programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: Working Group II (5th meeting), UN Convention on Biodiversity – COP 17
programme.desc: The 17th meeting of the Conference of the Parties (COP 17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) will take place in October 2026. It will be held in conjunction with the twelfth meeting of the Parties to the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety (CP-MOP-12) and the sixth meeting of the Parties to the Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing (NP-MOP-6). COP 17 will mark the first global review of collective progress towards the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF).

programme.title: Press Conference: Safeguarding the World's Most Biodiverse Areas: Industrial Threats and Solutions at the 30x30 Halfway Point, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: At the halfway point to 2030, there is a gap between conservation on paper and reality. A new global report found that nearly 61 million hectares of protected and conserved areas in the pantropics alone are overlapped by oil and gas blocks, and an additional 43 million hectares are overlapped by mining concessions at various stages of development. In too many places, key biodiversity areas remain unprotected, and Indigenous territories face growing threats. The report also spotlights proven pathways to high-integrity 30x30 implementation, including rights-based approaches that place Indigenous peoples and local communities at the center of stewardship, stronger safeguards against incompatible industrial activities, and policy shifts that align finance and development with nature. The findings of this report will be presented along with a direct call to Parties: Nature and biodiversity underpin global well-being, economic security, and cultural survival. Delivering Target 3 requires more than expanding the number of hectares on a map; it requires quality as well as quantity, ensuring conservation delivers durable outcomes in practice.

programme.title: Press Conference: From Aohan to Yerevan: China's Farmer-Led ABS Cited in the National Report — Women, Smallholders, Cooperatives and Enterprises Advancing Community Development and Sustainable Livelihoods, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: During the seventeenth meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17), a side event focused on farmer-led ABS and community seed banks will be held in Yerevan, Armenia. Taking China's Aohan Community Seed Bank as its core case, the event centers on the Aohan model officially cited in China's Seventh National Report to the CBD, demonstrating how women and ecological smallholders, smallholder cooperatives and enterprises can join forces in landrace conservation, seed multiplication, production and market linkages to advance community development and sustainable livelihoods. Rooted in the 8,000-year-old millet Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System (GIAHS), the Aohan model is built on community collective ownership of landrace germplasm, standardized two-tier community Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedures, farmer-negotiated Mutually Agreed Terms (MATs), and conservation-oriented, transparent benefit-sharing arrangements that connect communities, governments, research institutions and local enterprises. This practice offers a replicable and scalable model for community-level ABS implementation for staple food landraces in China and across the Global South. The side event will highlight the critical role of women and ecological smallholders in landrace conservation and community governance, and showcase the participation of smallholder cooperatives and enterprises in conservation, production and market development. Replication cases from Stone Village in Yunnan and Wangjingchuan in Hebei will be exchanged with Global South experiences including the Potato Park in Peru, CTDT in Zimbabwe and SEARICE in the Philippines, fostering South-South mutual learning and building a cross-continental practitioner network. The side event will also launch the 'Yerevan Declaration on Small-Scale Women Farmers for Biodiversity Conservation, Sustainable Use and Equal ABS,' calling for strengthened institutional support, technical guidance and sustainable financing for community seed systems and localized ABS implementation, in order to advance community development and sustainable livelihoods.

programme.title: Press Conference: Reverse the Red Accelerator Award Announcement, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: We will announce and celebrate the 2026 Reverse the Red Accelerator Award winners, recognising innovative projects that demonstrate leadership in species recovery through collaboration, measurable objectives and effective implementation. These projects showcase how targeted investment, partnership and strategic planning can accelerate recovery for threatened species while generating lessons that can be adapted across regions and taxa. The Reverse the Red Species Pledge is a practical mechanism for supporting implementation of Target 4. The Species Pledge maps the conservation actions already being undertaken for individual species, helping practitioners identify opportunities for collaboration, connect with peers working on similar challenges, strengthen strategic planning, and develop recovery objectives that align with the intent of Target 4. The Accelerator Award supports the best species pledges that are rapidly improving the status of species. By making conservation efforts more visible and connected, the initiative enables organisations to share expertise, celebrate progress and build a growing global community committed to reversing species declines.

programme.title: Press Conference: The Ranger Blindspot: Closing Global Policy Gaps, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: Rangers are almost entirely absent from official plans to protect 30% of land and sea by 2030, a paper has found – highlighting a glaring gap in countries' abilities to deliver sustainable and effective nature protection. The text analysis of 45 macro-governance documents (high-level policy and governance documents) and 21 National Biodiversity Strategies and Action Plans found that references to 'rangers' or equivalent terms were almost entirely absent, highlighting an oversight of the workforce needed to deliver sustainable and effective nature protection. Planning for area-based conservation targets without talking about rangers is like planning health targets without talking about doctors and nurses. Delivering 30x30 will depend heavily on effective area-based conservation. Rangers are a critical part of the workforce needed, supporting the establishment and effective management of protected and conserved areas, while working alongside Indigenous Peoples and local communities. Yet, their role remains largely absent from official plans to reverse biodiversity loss. This is the first empirical baseline of ranger workforce visibility. We argue that by not recognising rangers international conventions risk creating aspirational targets without the framework for implementation. The report calls on governments and those shaping conservation policy to recognise rangers as essential workers, and ensure they have the funding, support and legal protection they need to do their jobs.

programme.title: Press Conference: Obstacles to Achieving the KMGBF Targets in Armenia, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: The speakers will present an alternative picture to the progress towards achieving KMGBF Targets in Armenia drawing on specific cases. One of them is the mining project on Amulsar Mountain that has drawn strong criticism since the 2010s from the public in Armenia and internationally. Just one week before the opening of CBD COP17, the government of Armenia took part in a ceremony of launching the mining project. It has long been claimed that this project violates the CBD, the Bern Convention, and local legislation. The area is a candidate Emerald site; there is extensive scientific evidence documenting its adverse impacts; local communities have fought against the project for years and have been subjected to numerous forms of reprisals. In 2025, Armenia’s Administrative Court ruled that the project’s environmental impact assessment had not been properly conducted, as a result of which some of the mining licenses lost their validity, overall making mining in the site impossible. The ruling has been appealed and is not enforced yet. The speakers will also draw on systemic obstacles standing in the way of biodiversity conservation in general, such as weakened legal and political opportunities for local communities to protect their environment from polluting and harmful industries; low enforcement of regulations; streamlining finances elsewhere; prioritization of business interests, biodiversity offsetting schemes etc. Speakers: Levon Galstyan (geographer, environmental activist represented through Green Armenia NGO) Anna Shahnazaryan (environmental activist represented through Green Armenia NGO) Andrey Ralev (Cee Bankwatch Network, Biodiversity Campaigner)

programme.title: Press Conference: How Good Mining Governance Can Integrate Responsible Mining to Protect Biodiversity and the Rights of Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: This press conference will explore how good mining governance can integrate responsible mining practices with stronger safeguards for biodiversity and the rights of Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities (IPLCs). It will highlight the importance of robust regulations, transparent decision-making, corporate accountability, and meaningful community participation in ensuring that mining activities do not come at the expense of ecosystems, Indigenous territories, and local livelihoods. The discussion will emphasize the importance of restricted area maps as a governance tool to identify and protect ecologically sensitive areas, biodiversity hotspots, small islands, and Indigenous and community-managed territories from the harmful impacts of mining. It will also bring field-based perspectives from Kabaena and Pomalaa, Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia highlighting the environmental and social impacts of nickel mining on local communities, their livelihoods, and surrounding ecosystems. By connecting policy recommendations with realities on the ground, the press conference aims to identify concrete actions that governments, mining companies, and other stakeholders must take to strengthen responsible mining governance, protect biodiversity, respect community rights, and ensure accountability throughout the mining lifecycle.

programme.title: Press Conference: Taking Action for Nature through Strengthening the Science-Policy Interface: Lessons from EU-funded Projects, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: One of the ways through which the EU provides strategic support for biodiversity is through funding projects that aim to provide robust scientific evidence and connect these results to policymaking. Initiatives such as CO-OP4CBD, BioAgora, RESPIN, Biodiversa+ and NetworkNature aim to provide strategic support to the biodiversity science-policy interface through developing and supporting key processes that aim to improve the connection between researchers and policymakers. This press conference aims to explore our results, our successes and challenges we have faced along the way of taking efficient action for nature through strengtening the science-policy interface.

programme.title: Press Conference: From Review to Action: Human Rights-Based Approaches for Effective KMGBF Implementation, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: Human Rights Based Approach (HRBA) is a cross-cutting principle underpinning Section C of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF), which is to be understood, acted upon, implemented, reported, and evaluated, consistent with a number of key considerations and requirements, including a HRBA and a whole-of-society approach. However, the Global Report tells us that we are off track in achieving the framework's goals and targets, with both ambition and implementation gaps that need to be addressed. It further indicates that 'there has been uneven progress on issues related to rights and equity, equitable governance, and participation of rights holders and other actors.' In this context, efforts to accelerate implementation and address gaps, challenges, and barriers, including in accessing means of implementation, need to be framed with more attention and grounded in stronger application of HRBA and whole-of-society approaches. Outcome of the Global Review should prioritize further developing inclusive, rights-based and gender-responsive approaches to support accelerated and more effective implementation of the Framework. This includes recognizing rights holders as partners in implementation, promoting and ensuring full, equitable, inclusive, effective, and gender-responsive participation and representation of Indigenous Peoples and local communities, women, youth, persons with disabilities, people of African descent embodying traditional lifestyles, and other relevant stakeholders in implementation, biodiversity-related policy, and decision-making to achieve the 2030 mission.

programme.title: Press Conference: How can the Philippines Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan (PBSAP) be implemented across the Biodiversity-Climate-Agri-food and Human Rights Nexus? Outcomes of the Multi-Actor Dialogue, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: SEARICE, Tebtebba, PIK-P and SwedBio organised a two day Multi-Actor Dialogue: 'Exploring Opportunities for Cross-Sector Collaboration for Philippines Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan (PBSAP) Implementation across the Biodiversity–Climate–Agri-food and Human Rights Nexus' on June 30 – July 1, 2026 in Tagaytay City, Philippines. The PBSAP 2024-2040 has been officially submitted, and various government agencies are finalizing their implementation plans. Ensuring a whole-of-government and whole-of-society approach to biodiversity conservation is crucial in this context. With the aim to promote synergies and collaboration across sectors and agencies to enhance understanding of the vital link between biodiversity, sustainable agri-food systems, climate resilience, and human rights-based approaches (HRBA), the dialogue gathered 53 representatives from government and UN agencies, indigenous peoples, farmers and fisherfolk and civil society organizations to to explore inclusive collaboration. The dialogue aimed to co-develop actionable recommendations to strengthen the integrated implementation of the PBSAP 2024-2040. Amongst other things, discussions highlighted the importance of inclusive participation, indigenous and local knowledge systems, policy coherence, and stronger partnerships in advancing the implementation of the PBSAP. The dialogue also created new connections and opportunities for continued collaboration among participants – central for turning national commitments into lasting impact through continued cross sector dialogue. In this press conference additional outcomes of the dialogue will be presented along with the world's first Indigenous Peoples' Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan (IPBSAP) of the Philippines and next steps to be taken to ensure cross-sector collaboration when implementing the PBSAP. About the organisers: SwedBio - a Swedish based biodiversity programme at Stockholm Resilience Centre at Stockholm University, funded by Sida, collaborating with partner organizations across policy and practice around the world. TEBTEBBA - Indigenous Peoples' International Centre for Policy Research and Education is an indigenous peoples' organization born out of the need for heightened advocacy to have the rights of indigenous peoples respected, protected and fulfilled worldwide. SEARICE - is a regional NGO that empowers farming communities across Southeast Asia to advance sustainable agri-food systems through agroecology, agricultural biodiversity conservation, and rights-based policy advocacy for a just agri-food system. PIKP - Partners for Indigenous Knowledge Philippines, Inc. (PIKP) is a learning network based in Baguio City in the Philippines working to promote and strengthen indigenous peoples' knowledge and their contributions to cultural and biological diversity through documentation, research, intergenerational transmission, community development, networking and national and international engagement and policy advocacy.

programme.title: Press Conference: What Civil Society Should Watch and What They Mean for Indonesia, UN Convention on Biodiversity - COP 17
programme.desc: What Should Civil Society Watch at COP17? Key Decisions and What They Mean for Indonesia COP17 in Yerevan is expected to address a number of critical issues for the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KM-GBF), including biodiversity finance, Access and Benefit-Sharing (ABS), Other Effective area-based Conservation Measures (OECMs), harmful incentives and subsidies, and the rights and participation of Indigenous Peoples and local communities. This press conference will highlight key decisions that civil society should watch at COP17, what they mean for biodiversity governance and implementation in Indonesia, and what remains unresolved. The discussion will also look ahead to Indonesia's potential role as host of COP18 and the opportunities and responsibilities this could bring for advancing an inclusive and effective biodiversity agenda.

programme.title: Working Group II (7th meeting), UN Convention on Biodiversity – COP 17
programme.desc: The 17th meeting of the Conference of the Parties (COP 17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) will take place in October 2026. It will be held in conjunction with the twelfth meeting of the Parties to the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety (CP-MOP-12) and the sixth meeting of the Parties to the Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing (NP-MOP-6). COP 17 will mark the first global review of collective progress towards the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF).

programme.title: Lake Magic
programme.desc: Mini land-bound oceans, lakes are a treasure trove of aquatic wonders. Lakes make up just 3% of the Earth's surface, but they hold 180,000 square kilometres of fresh water. From the shoreline to their depths are unique habitats teaming with life, home to everything from birds and bugs to frogs and fish. They can be anything from sanctuary from land predators and temperature regulators to bountiful food sources and pit-stops for migrating birdlife. Take a deep breath and dive into the magical world of lakes!

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Masked Bandits
programme.desc: The masked bandits come with a reputation for trouble and mischief, and while they're certainly cunning and creative, they're also social, loyal and cuddly! From red pandas and badgers to coatis and, of course, raccoons – we'll cast any animal with a stripe across their eyes as pesky troublemakers. Take a moment to look past their robber masks and you'll find a remarkable set of creatures with stories you'll find nowhere else in the animal kingdom. It's time to lift the veil on the masked bandits!

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Embark on an immersive journey through the heart of the Indo-Pacific as we explore the breathtaking coral reef ecosystem, home to an array of vibrant fish species and magnificent manta rays. Let's unearth the secrets of a prehistoric cave nestled within this underwater wonderland and marvel at the stunning beauty of the shoals of fish that dance around us. The vibrant colors and intricate details of this marine paradise offer a mesmerizing glimpse into the world beneath the waves that captivate with the majesty and wonder of the coral reef, as we witness nature at its most spectacular.

programme.title: Little Cats
programme.desc: From mysterious lynx to athletic servals and water-bound jungle cats, the little cats of the world are some of the most fascinating and ruthless predators on the planet.

programme.title: Wonderful Wetlands
programme.desc: Water is the key to life. It provides a haven for countless plants and animals, everything from water-loving cats and predatory birds to killer dragonflies and carnivorous foliage. It can be a nursery, a migration stopover and a larder. And there's place where water is gathered, drained and stored for all to enjoy – the wetland. Wetlands are some of the most remarkable ecosystems in the natural world everything from dragonflies and bats to fish and amphibians can thrive thanks to the wonderful wetland.
